title: Tempura lunch · Koenji vintage · Nakano Broadway · Fuunji tsukemen · Harajuku to Shibuya · MEGA Donki · ATOM last big night

stops.name: Tempura Shinjuku Tsunahachi Tsunohazuan
stops.plan: Brunch-lunch for 8 at Shinjuku's historic tempura house: lunch sets are the budget way in (book by phone for 8).
stops.transport: Walk to JR Shinjuku, Chuo line rapid Shinjuku → Koenji (about 6 min, weekdays only), walk 3 min

stops.name: Koenji vintage crawl (Pal & Look arcades, Kita-Kore Building)
stops.plan: Pal arcade south into Look toward Shin-Koenji, then cross north for Kita-Kore's punk and archive shops; split into 2–3 groups, meet at the station.
stops.transport: JR Chuo line Koenji → Nakano (2 min), walk 5 min up Sun Mall

stops.name: Nakano Broadway
stops.plan: Floors 2–4: Mandarake branches for figures, retro toys, cards and idol goods, calmer and cheaper than Akihabara. Two groups.
stops.transport: JR Chuo line rapid Nakano → Shinjuku (about 5 min), walk 8 min from the South Exit

stops.name: Fuunji
stops.plan: Be in the queue for the 17:00 dinner opening; order the tokusei tsukemen. Counter only, so seat in waves.
stops.transport: Walk 5 min to Yoyogi, JR Yamanote line Yoyogi → Harajuku (2 min), walk 2 min to Takeshita-dori

stops.name: Harajuku → Ura-Hara → Cat Street walk (atmos, Kicks Lab, 2nd Street)
stops.plan: Quick pass down Takeshita (crepes), then Ura-Hara back lanes and Cat Street south for atmos, Kicks Lab and 2nd Street; most shops shut around 20:00, so hit the must-buys first.
stops.transport: Walk 5 min to Omotesando, Tokyo Metro Hanzomon line Omotesando → Shibuya (2 min), walk 8 min to MEGA Don Quijote (about 30 min door to door)

stops.name: MEGA Don Quijote Shibuya Main Store
stops.plan: Final take-home haul, with time to cover every floor: snacks, KitKats, cosmetics, costumes. Pay one receipt each (¥5,000+ ex-tax) on your own passport for the tax-free refund at Haneda tomorrow.
stops.transport: Walk 6 min up Dogenzaka to Maruyamacho

stops.name: ATOM SHIBUYA
stops.plan: Last big night: in before 23:30 for the cheap Monday entry (one drink included). Original passports required, no sandals or sports pants.
stops.transport: Taxi to Shinjuku 3-chome (2 cars, 20 min); trains have stopped

stops.name: Isomaru Suisan Shinjuku 3-chome
stops.plan: 24-hour grill-it-yourself seafood izakaya: scallops, crab-miso shells and highballs as the last feed of the trip.
stops.price: about ¥2,500–4,000 pp with drinks (+10% late-night surcharge)
stops.transport: Walk 12 min home to Garfield House
